items.name: Electrical design basis and philosophy
items.content: System voltages (utility, 13.8 kV/4.16 kV/480 V/120-208 V), short-circuit design limits, redundancy (main-tie-main), motor voltage by kW range, motor efficiency (NEMA Premium), enclosure, starting philosophy, essential/UPS loads, grounding method (resistance-grounded MV), codes and standards list.

items.name: Motor and electrical requirements for mechanical/vendor specs
items.content: Electrical requirements section for driven-equipment and package specs: motor voltage by size, frequency, enclosure (TEFC/explosion-proof), insulation class, service factor, space heaters, winding RTDs, IEEE 841, VFD-duty requirements, package MCC/panel supply rules, local control station requirements.

items.name: Preliminary power demand estimate
items.content: Connected kW, running kW, peak demand MW/MVA, power factor, essential load MW, largest motor size, growth margin; by unit/area.

items.name: Utility interconnect requirements
items.content: Point of interconnection, service voltage, available three-phase and SLG fault MVA and X/R (max/min), utility protection and metering requirements, revenue metering, power quality limits (IEEE 519), backfeed date, utility-owned vs owner-owned equipment boundary.

items.name: Utility interconnection application and load forecast
items.content: Formal application to utility: forecast demand by year, largest motor, harmonic sources, single-line at POI; supports owner commercial agreement and schedule.

items.name: Preliminary key one-line diagram
items.content: Main substation, transformers (MVA, voltages), MV/LV distribution, number of substations, emergency generator and UPS, selected configuration with rationale.

items.name: Electrical estimate quantities and pricing
items.content: Major equipment list with budget prices, bulk quantities (cable by size, tray, conduit, grounding, lighting fixtures, heat tracing), installation hours basis, by WBS/area.

items.name: Hazardous area release source list
items.content: Per source: equipment/tag, fluid, NFPA 497 group, AIT, temperature class, grade of release, ventilation, Class/Division (or Zone), extent per API RP 500/505 figure reference.

items.name: Hazardous area classification drawings
items.content: Plan and elevation drawings with Class I Div 1/Div 2 (or Zone 0/1/2) boundaries, gas group, temperature class, unclassified buildings, pressurized rooms; issued to all disciplines, vendors and construction.

items.name: Equipment certification requirements by area
items.content: Per area/equipment tag: Class/Division or Zone, gas group, T-code; used by MECH (motors, packages), INST (instruments, junction boxes), CIVL (HVAC), vendors.

items.name: Substation and electrical building requirements to civil
items.content: Building footprint, ceiling height, equipment arrangement, floor loads and equipment weights, cable vault/raised floor/cable entry, doors and maintenance clearances (NEC 110.26), transformer pads, oil containment volumes, fire separation, battery room ventilation, blast rating.

items.name: Electrical building HVAC and pressurization requirements
items.content: Heat dissipation per room (kW) for switchgear, MCC, VFD, UPS, transformers; design temperatures/humidity; battery hydrogen ventilation; positive pressurization and purge per NFPA 496; HVAC power supply needs back to ELEC.

items.name: Prefabricated E-house scope definition
items.content: Decision on stick-built vs E-house, modules, shipping splits, equipment included, skid foundation interface.

items.name: Electrical load list
items.content: Per load: tag, description, P&ID, area, kW/HP, voltage, phases, efficiency, PF, duty, demand factor, bus/MCC assignment, essential/UPS flag, starter type (DOL/RVSS/VFD); summary by bus and switchboard.

items.name: Plant power demand summary to process and owner
items.content: Total electrical demand (normal, peak, essential), per-unit kWh/yr for utility balance and opex; issued to PROC utility balance and OWNR.

items.name: Electrical P&ID review comments
items.content: Markups: missing motor tags, MOV/EOV electrical data, heat tracing notes, start/stop and interlock representation, ESD trip of motors, VFD symbols.

items.name: Electrical equipment ratings
items.content: Transformer MVA, voltage, %Z, cooling; switchgear bus and interrupting ratings; MCC sizes and bucket counts; generator kW/kVA; UPS kVA and battery Ah/autonomy; spare capacity.

items.name: Single-line diagrams
items.content: Main, MV, LV and MCC one-lines: buses, breakers, transformers, feeders, cable references, protection relays (ANSI devices), CTs/PTs, metering, interlocks, normal/tie/standby schemes.

items.name: MV switchgear requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: voltage, continuous/interrupting ratings, arc-resistant construction (IEEE C37.20.7), relays, communication protocol, I/O to DCS/ECMS, testing and documentation requirements.

items.name: Power transformer requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: MVA, voltages, %Z, vector group, OLTC/NLTC, cooling, neutral grounding resistor, oil containment data, losses evaluation basis, testing.

items.name: LV switchgear, MCC and E-house requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: buses, starter schedule (bucket list), intelligent MCC protocol, E-house structure, HVAC, fire detection, internal lighting and shipping splits.

items.name: VFD requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: motor list on VFD, ratings, pulse number/active front end, IEEE 519 limits, bypass, motor compatibility (inverter-duty), DCS interface.

items.name: UPS, DC and generator requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: UPS kVA, autonomy, battery type, DC charger rating, generator kW, fuel and tank autonomy, ATS, NFPA 110 level, emissions tier.

items.name: Electrical technical bid evaluations
items.content: Technical compliance tables, accepted deviations, clarifications, recommended vendor per requisition, technical conditions for PO.

items.name: Electrical vendor document comments
items.content: Coded returns (approved, approved with comments, rejected) with markups on GA, schematics and datasheets.

items.name: Certified electrical equipment data
items.content: Certified transformer %Z/X/R, losses, switchgear dimensions/weights, breaker and relay models, CT ratios, heat loss; keyed into SPEL and ETAP and passed to CIVL for foundations.

items.name: Motor data review comments

items.name: Certified motor data

items.name: Arc flash study and labels

items.name: Ground grid study

items.name: Lightning protection design
